213:t_000:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I tried pulling up $$ジェニオン$$'s data, and... it looks like we're in the center of the galaxy...」

213:t_000:7.en:
$n
「The center of the galaxy... Then that $$時空震動|lc$$ threw us all the way here...」

213:t_000:8.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Yeah... It looks like we're drifting through this sea of stars...」

218:t_1:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

218:t_1:6.en:
$$エイミー$$
「So those are the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ that $$レド$$ and the others were fighting...」

218:t_1:8.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What the hell is going on here!? Where are we right now!?」

218:t_1:9.en:
$$レド$$
「Just think of it as exactly the reverse of what happened to me.」

218:t_1:11.en:
$$エイミー$$
「So we've come to the place where $$レド$$ was fighting?」

218:t_1:13.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey...! Can't we go home!?」

218:t_1:16.en:
$$レド$$
「Ultra-long-range hyperspace navigation that crosses roughly half the galaxy has not been established...」

218:t_1:17.en:
$$レド$$
「The same is true of this $$マクロス・クォーター$$.」

218:t_1:21.en:
$$エイミー$$
「If that's how it is, then all we can do is keep on living, right?」

218:t_1:23.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Even you got thrown here all alone, and you're giving it your all with the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ and $c. It's the same for me.」

218:t_1:25.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Hey, $$レド$$... This is where you used to be, isn't it...」

218:t_1:26.en:
$$エイミー$$
「In that case, will you go back to the $$人類銀河同盟$$?」

218:t_1:28.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey, Tin Can! Is there any way to get back to that whatever Alliance!」

218:t_1:29.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「To answer, more detailed position data is required.」

218:t_1:30.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「However, the chance of rejoining the $$人類銀河同盟$$ is at least higher than when we were on Earth.」

218:t_1:31.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Looks like you can go back, $$レド$$!」

218:t_1:32.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I request Ensign $$レド$$'s decision on that matter.」

218:t_1:33.en:
$$レド$$
「...Confirming the situation comes first right now. I'll think about the Alliance later.」

218:t_1:35.en:
$$レド$$
(Until $$エイミー$$ asked me, I never even thought about returning...)

218:t_1:36.en:
$$レド$$
(What do I... want to do...?)

218:t_1:37.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「So that's a $$マシンキャリバー$$ of the $$人類銀河同盟$$...」

218:t_1:39.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I've never encountered them myself, but the data the 《$$ギャラクシー船団$$》 holds includes some on them as well.」

218:t_1:41.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Like our $$フロンティア船団$$, it's one of the ultra-long-range emigrant fleets.」

218:t_1:42.en:
$$ルカ$$
「In the $$再世戦争$$, they tried to exploit the power of the $$バジュラ$$ and fought us.」

218:t_1:43.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「With my mind controlled, I fought $$アルト$$ and the others as one of their soldiers.」

218:t_1:44.en:
$$アルト$$
「But $$ブレラ$$ was freed from that and became a member of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

218:t_1:45.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Then why is he in the middle of the galaxy?」

218:t_1:46.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「In the $$時空震動|lc$$ right after the $$再世戦争$$, I was transferred to the center of the galaxy.」

218:t_1:47.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Being a cyborg, I shut down my physiological functions and drifted through space sending out a distress signal, and about nine months later the $$マクロス７船団$$ took me in.」

218:t_1:48.en:
$$アルト$$
「I see... I thought $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ was the only one that got transferred to the same world as us, but...」

218:t_1:49.en:
$$アルト$$
「So the $$マクロス７船団$$ came here too.」

218:t_1:50.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「$$アルト$$... I heard $$ランカ$$ is on this ship too...」

218:t_1:52.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$ブレラ$$... Sorry to ask, but would you go see $$ランカ$$?」

218:t_1:53.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I don't mind, but is $$ランカ$$ unwell?」

218:t_1:54.en:
$$オズマ$$
「She's had a few emotional shocks in a row...」

218:t_1:55.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Even with Major $$オズマ$$ and $$アルト$$ by her side...?」

218:t_1:58.en:
$$オズマ$$
「...All hands, stand by as you are. Once the captain of $$バトル７$$ and our representative finish talking, we'll be briefed on the situation as well.」

218:t_1:59.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Until then, each of you sort out your feelings and be ready for any situation.」

218:t_1:62.en:
$$クラン$$
「Having run into a situation like this, I can't dismiss those words as an exaggerated threat.」

218:t_1:63.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「What's going to happen to us...」

218:t_1:64.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Don't worry so much! We've got allies in the $$マクロス７船団$$, too!」

218:t_1:65.en:
$$アマタ$$
「That's right. A coincidence like this happening in the vast universe is truly a miracle.」

218:t_1:66.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「A miracle, huh... If this really is a coincidence, I guess that's all you can call it.」

218:t_1:67.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Come to think of it, I had a feeling $$ブレラ$$ was about to say something about that.」

218:t_1:68.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「We can confirm it once $$ランカ$$-chan's talk is over.」

218:t_1:70.en:
$$カイエン$$
「What's wrong, $$アルト$$? Is something bothering you?」

218:t_1:71.en:
$$アルト$$
「...The $$マクロス７船団$$ should be organized the same as us, the $$フロンティア船団$$.」

218:t_1:72.en:
$$アルト$$
「But the only ship here is $$バトル７$$, the flagship of the fleet escort force.」

218:t_1:74.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「A single ship acting alone... Maybe $$バトル７$$ is on some kind of mission.」

218:t_1:75.en:
$$ルカ$$
「So $$ブレラ$$ was going on ahead to carry out that mission...?」

218:t_1:76.en:
$$アルト$$
「It'll all be clear soon enough.」

218:t_1:77.en:
$$アマタ$$
「But what we have to do is already decided.」
